title: Analysis of pairs in a generalized deck of playing cards
summary: In this study, we analyze the number of pairs (i.e., two cards of the same rank) in a set of cards randomly selected from a deck of playing cards. While the standard deck of playing cards comprises 52 cards excluding the joker with 4 suits and 13 ranks, our analysis considers a generalized deck where the numbers of suits and ranks can be set arbitrarily. We derive the exact formulas for the mean and variance of the number of pairs in a given number of cards randomly selected from this generalized deck, expressed using the Gauss hypergeometric function.
